title: 2 New England spots make NYT’s list of best Mexican restaurants
author: Madison Lucchesi
bullets: Tuxpan Taqueria in Central Falls, RI, and Food Truck Paradise in New Haven, CT, are top U.S. Mexican eateries.
The New York Times' list includes Connecticut's Food Truck Paradise known for 'tricked-out bebidas' and diverse cuisine.
Tuxpan Taqueria in Rhode Island was a 2023 James Beard Semifinalist, noted for its chicken Milanesa torta and tacos.

title: Are tire rotations necessary for electric vehicles?
author: John Paul
bullets: Tire rotations on electric vehicles like a 2023 Nissan Leaf are important to maximize tread life due to quick wear.
Electric vehicles wear tires faster due to instant torque and additional weight, necessitating regular rotations for optimal life.
Properly inflated tires on electric vehicles should still be rotated regularly even if they appear to wear evenly.

title: Patriots place Terrell Jennings on IR, sign two more running backs
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: The Patriots placed running back Terrell Jennings on injured reserve with an undisclosed injury.
New England signed running backs JaMychal Hasty and Hasan Haskins for additional depth.
Myles Montgomery also placed on IR; competition tight for the third RB spot behind Stevenson and Henderson.

title: Celtics release 2026-27 schedule: When will Jaylen Brown return to Boston?
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Jaylen Brown will return to Boston on January 21, 2027, after being traded to the 76ers.
The 2026-27 Celtics season opens on October 20 with a game against the Detroit Pistons.
The Celtics will face the New York Knicks, NBA champions, in their home opener on October 23.

title: Payton Tolle pitches 8-inning gem as Red Sox end 5-game skid with 7-0 win over Blue Jays
author: The Associated Press
bullets: Red Sox rookie Payton Tolle allowed two hits over eight innings in a 7-0 victory against the Blue Jays.
Caleb Durbin hit a grand slam and had three hits, contributing significantly to the Red Sox's offensive effort.
The win ended Boston's five-game losing streak, keeping them in position for an AL wild-card playoff berth.

title: Patriots 10, Colts 7 (2nd): Who will stand out in Patriots’ preseason opener?
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Patriots' preseason opener against Colts involves players fighting for roster spots as several starters like Drake Maye sit out.
Player highlights include Kyle Williams' 12-yard touchdown catch and Anthony Richardson's rushing TD for the Colts.
Patriots force turnovers with Kindle Vildor's interception and KJ Britt's forced fumble recovered by Isaiah Iton.

title: Cape Cod documentarian Mischa Richter creates a dreamy ode to Grateful Dead culture with ‘Summer Tour’
author: Lauren Daley
bullets: Mischa Richter's documentary 'Summer Tour' explores Grateful Dead culture and its enduring community on their final tour in 2023.
The film follows two young Deadheads, Jerry Pierce and Annie Dunn, as they travel in a camper van across the country.
Richter will participate in Q&A sessions at screenings in Dennis, MA, and Westerly, RI, with more dates to follow.

title: Tiffani Faison to close Sweet Cheeks Q and Fool’s Errand in the Fenway
author: Nathan Tavares
bullets: Tiffani Faison will close Sweet Cheeks Q and Fool's Errand in Fenway by November 24, after 15 years.
Faison cites rising costs, including high gas prices and tariffs, as factors in the decision to close.
Sweet Cheeks Q is renowned for its barbecue and biscuits, frequently named Boston's best BBQ.

title: Take a look inside New Hampshire’s oldest continuously operated inn after a makeover
author: Kristi Palma
bullets: The Inn at Hancock in New Hampshire reopened in May following a three-year, multi-million dollar renovation.
Renovations were led by Kerri Landry and involved collaboration with designer Jeffrey Delvy.
Nightly rates at the inn start at $620, with three dining venues and a variety of outdoor activities nearby.

title: Acton teen accused of killing mom, brother ordered held without bail
author: Ross Cristantiello
bullets: Arjun Aravind, 17, from Acton, was charged with killing his mother and brother and is held without bail.
Prosecutors report signs of a violent struggle; blunt force trauma believed to be used in the killings.
Aravind, arrested in Wayland, faces multiple charges; he will undergo a mental health evaluation.
